Camera exposure compensation in EV stops. Per agx-emulsion parity: this is camera.exposure_compensation_ev, applied as 2^EV multiplication to film exposure. Positive values brighten the image.
Enable the camera auto meter (agx-emulsion camera.auto_exposure). Scanner auto exposure remains independent.
Choose a film format preset; the selected long edge is written to the editable control below.
Longest capture dimension in millimeters; used for micrometer-to-pixel conversions.

Choose the spectral reconstruction method used for film exposure. Hanatos uses the Hanatos 2025 LUT when available; Mallett uses the Mallett 2019 sRGB basis reconstruction; Arctic uses the Arctic 2026 beta04 reflectance LUT.
Compress out-of-domain input chromaticities before TC spectral reconstruction.
Apply the Hanatos 2025 bandpass adaptation window when reconstructing spectra.
Apply the Hanatos 2025 surface adaptation polynomial when reconstructing spectra.
User cyan offset carried as FilmJuicerMainCFilterShift at the print recipe boundary.
Adjust film-development contrast. Below 1 reduces contrast; above 1 increases contrast.
Adjust print-medium development contrast. Below 1 reduces contrast; above 1 increases contrast.
Global multiplier on the DIR inhibition matrix.
Sigma in micrometers for spatial diffusion of the DIR correction.
Negative-film normalized donor knees in RGB order. Values above the display range may be entered numerically.
Positive-film normalized receiver knees in RGB order. Values above the display range may be entered numerically.
Physical DIR tail sigma in micrometers; consumed only when spatial DIR and tail weight are active.
Tail mixture weight; consumed only while the spatial DIR core is active.
Use the selected film profile's DIR gamma values.
Same-layer DIR gamma in donor RGB order.
DIR inhibition from the R layer onto G and B.
DIR inhibition from the G layer onto R and B.
DIR inhibition from the B layer onto R and G.
Gaussian blur sigma in pixels for scanner optics.
Unsharp sigma (px) and amount applied after scanner blur.
Cube resolution for scanner spectral LUTs.
Add profile-derived scatter and halation to the negative raw exposure.
Scale in-emulsion scatter strength in the capture film.
Scale the in-emulsion scatter radius in the capture film.
Scale profile-derived back-reflection strength in the capture film.
Scale the profile-derived back-reflection radius in the capture film.
Starting point for grain size/strength presets.
Grain amount in stops (EV); scales OD delta.
Reset advanced grain controls to the base values.
Particle area in um^2; roughly 0.1 for ISO 100-200, 0.4 for ISO 400.
Master control for particle scale; adjusts RGB values together.
Master control for sublayer particle scale; adjusts RGB values together.
Master control for minimum grain density; adjusts RGB values together.
Master control for grain uniformity; adjusts RGB values together.
Scale factor for dye cloud blur sigma in pixels.
Weight of the coarse grain population in the size mixture.
Weight of the mid grain population in the size mixture.
Relative particle size scale for the coarse grain population.
Micro-structure parameters: clump cell size (um) and clump sigma (x1e-3).
Debug view selector for grain delta fields (pre-scanner).
Scale of particle area for the RGB layers (multiplies particle area).
Scale of particle area for sublayers in each color layer.
Modulates clump strength over time (0 = static, higher = more breathing).
Seconds for clump field to evolve; longer is more stable.
Scales the global gate weave (film transport jitter).
Dust carried by the moving film.
Dust that stays fixed while the picture moves through the gate.
Light damage carried by the moving film.
Fine persistent marks in the scan/gate path.
Apply diffusion on the camera stage before film exposure.
PSF family used on the camera stage before film exposure.
Commercial filter stop: 0, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, or 2; intermediate values are supported.
Multiplier on the camera-stage image-plane PSF widths.
Additive camera-stage halo warmth offset. Positive warms the outer halo; negative inverts it.
Multiplier on the camera-stage core weight. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the camera-stage core size. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the camera-stage halo weight. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the camera-stage halo size. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the camera-stage bloom weight. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the camera-stage bloom size. 1.0 uses the family default.
Apply diffusion on the print stage after enlarger exposure is formed.
PSF family used on the print stage after enlarger exposure is formed.
Commercial filter stop: 0, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, or 2; intermediate values are supported.
Multiplier on the print-stage image-plane PSF widths.
Additive print-stage halo warmth offset. Positive warms the outer halo; negative inverts it.
Multiplier on the print-stage core weight. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the print-stage core size. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the print-stage halo weight. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the print-stage halo size. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the print-stage bloom weight. 1.0 uses the family default.
Multiplier on the print-stage bloom size. 1.0 uses the family default.
Add glare to the print (scanner-stage stray light).
Percentage of glare light (typ. 0.10-0.25). Value is in percent, not fraction.
Gaussian blur sigma in pixels applied to the glare field.
Apply print shadow compensation to density curves. 0.2 = 20% underexposed shadows. Intended as alternative to stochastic glare (set GlarePercent=0).
Density at which the compensation-removal transition is centered (typ. 1.0-1.5).
Transition density range for compensation removal (typ. 0.1-0.5).
Disable to output linear RGB in the selected output color space. Output remains clipped to 0-1.
Compress destination-linear highlights and chroma before scanner optics.
